start: A saved member's page as owner, on a computer with a webcam, camera allowed

steps.action: Tap 'Take photo'
user_sees: The live camera preview
must_not: A mirrored preview that flips after the picture is taken

steps.action: Take the picture and save
user_sees: The centre square is kept, made small (400 px side or less, shrunk in steps until small enough) and shown on the member
must_not: A stretched face; a small webcam picture blown up; a save shown as done when the server refused it

start: The same member as owner; the other way in: 'Upload a photo'

steps.action: Tap 'Upload a photo' and pick a JPG, PNG or HEIC picture under 25 MB
user_sees: The same square photo on the member
must_not: A file accepted only by its name while it is not a picture; a photo over the server's size limit sent

start: As owner: camera blocked, no camera, camera in use; then wrong files; then a member not yet on the server

steps.action: Tap 'Take photo' with the camera blocked / missing / busy / unsupported
user_sees: 'The camera is blocked. Tap the camera or lock icon next to the web address, choose Allow, then reload the page. Or tap Upload a photo.' / 'No camera was found on this computer. Tap Upload a photo to pick a picture instead.' / 'The camera is in use by another app. Close that app and tap Try again, or tap Upload a photo.' / 'This browser can’t use the camera. Tap Upload a photo to pick a picture instead.'
must_not: A blank black box with no words; a prompt that returns on every tap

steps.action: Pick an empty file, a 30 MB file, a PDF
user_sees: 'That file has no picture in it. Pick another photo.' / 'That file is too big. Pick a photo under 25 MB.' / 'That file is not a photo. Pick a JPG or PNG picture.'
must_not: The file opened and the page frozen

steps.action: Save a photo for a member added seconds ago while offline
user_sees: 'This member is not saved yet. Check the internet, wait a minute, then add the photo on their page.'
must_not: The photo lost with no word; the photo saved on another member

start: As owner, a member with a photo

steps.action: Take a new photo and save
user_sees: The new photo everywhere the member shows (page, list, member card)
must_not: The old photo still on the card; both photos kept on the server

steps.action: Remove the photo (if the page offers it; not read)
user_sees: Initials in place of the photo
must_not: A broken-picture mark; the file left readable by its old address
